name: Glint
description: Palette derived from glintpay.com's live CSS variables: indigo-navy neutral ladder (ink #0a0e1f / mirage #141b3d / burst #1f295c / astro #29367a, hue 272), electric action blue (--c-blue #3d5cf5, hue 269), cherry/malachite/usafa semantics, lilac highlight. Chroma re-anchored to those hexes on 11 Aug 2026 (Ali: the blue read dull next to the app): neutral 0.45 -> 0.85 so the navy surfaces match ink/mirage/burst/astro instead of sitting at half their chroma, primary 1.3 -> 1.35 so L 0.55 lands on #3d5cf5 exactly. Accent stays the metal gold (hue 87 at 0.78) here; the Studio copy of this theme has accent re-hued to the action blue. Density moved tight -> default (11 Aug). Card style flat -> elevated (11 Aug): flat paints the card with --muted, which the generator sets to the SAME value as --input and --border, so outlined inputs sitting on a card were invisible; elevated puts the card on --card, a step below the input chrome. Input chrome overridden to neutral 700 in dark mode (11 Aug): the generator maps card to n900 and muted/border/input all to n800, so an outlined field sitting on a card was one ramp step from its own background and read as no field at all.
